reason: The README describes an AI-agent skill pack primarily for automating Sealos Cloud application deployments and provisioning connected databases and object storage, with project inspection, artifact preparation, environment wiring, and deployment verification.

summaries.zh: 用于通过 AI 智能体分析项目并自动部署到 Sealos Cloud，同时配置云数据库和 S3 兼容对象存储。
summaries.en: An AI-agent skill pack for analyzing projects, deploying them to Sealos Cloud, and configuring cloud databases and S3-compatible object storage.

capabilities: Inspect project structure and runtime requirements
Prepare deployment artifacts and container images
Deploy applications to Sealos Cloud and verify rollouts
Create and connect Sealos Cloud databases
Create and configure S3-compatible object storage
Display verified deployment resources in a local read-only canvas
